newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Sept trade surplus $28 billion - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Sept trade surplus $28 billion - agency.

text.p: Russia had a trade surplus of $28 billion in the first nine months of 1996 after growth in exports exceeded a rise in imports, Interfax news agency said on Friday, citing Foreign Economic Relations Ministry figures.
The figures, which included trade with the Commonwealth of Indpendent States, are different from non-CIS trade figures released last month by the State Statistics Committee.
Interfax said the imports figures did not include imports by small private "shuttle" traders.
The State Statistics Committee last month put the nine-month surplus, excluding trade with the CIS, at $17.2 billion.
